verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              पुलस्त्यस्य तु यः क्रोधादर्धदेहोऽभवन्मुनिः। विश्रवा नाम सक्रोधः स वैश्रवणमैक्षत॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : The ascetic Vishrava, who was begotten of the half body of Pulastya, with great anger began to look upon Vaishravana.

verses.sanskrit: बुबुधे तं तु सक्रोधं पितरं राक्षसेश्वरः। कुबेरस्तत्प्रसादार्थं यतते स्म सदा नृप॥२॥
verses.english: Knowing that his sire was angry with him, Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas, always tried to please him, O king.

verses.sanskrit: स राजराजो लङ्कायां न्यवसन्नरवाहनः। राक्षसीः प्रददौ तिस्रः पितुर्वै परिचारिकाः॥३॥
verses.english: Living in Lanka that king of kings, borne on the shoulders of men, sent three Rakshasis to wait upon his father.
verses.bhavadeepa: पुलस्त्यस्येति । पितरं विश्रवसं राक्षसेश्वरः कुबेरो रक्षः पुरीनायकत्वात् ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: ताः सदा तं महात्मानं सन्तोषयितुमुद्यताः। ऋषिं भरतशार्दूल नृत्यगीतविशारदाः॥४॥
verses.english: O foremost of the Bharata, they, well-versed in the art of singing and dancing, always engaged in encompassing the pleasure of the high-souled Rishi.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोत्कटा च राका च मालिनी च विशाम्पते। अन्योन्यस्पर्धया राजन् श्रेयस्कामाः सुमध्यमाः॥५॥
verses.english: O lord of the world, O king, Pushpotkata and Raka and Malini, slender waisted, vied with one another in pleasing him.

verses.sanskrit: स तासां भगवांस्तुष्टो महात्मा प्रददौ वरान्। लोकपालोपमान् पुत्रानेकैकस्या यथेप्सितान्॥६॥
verses.english: Being pleased with them, the high-souled sage conferred boons on them-and on each of them sons like Lokapalas according to their desire.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोत्कटायां जज्ञाते द्वौ पुत्रौ राक्षसेश्वरौ। कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ बलेनाप्रतिमौ भुवि॥७॥
verses.english: He begot on Pushpotkata two sons, the lords of the Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna and the tenheaded (Ravana) both unequalled in prowess on earth.

verses.sanskrit: मालिनी जनयामास पुत्रमेकं विभीषणम्। राकायां मिथुनं जज्ञे खरः शूर्पणखा तथा॥८॥
verses.english: On Malini he begot one son named Vibhishana; on Raka he begot one son and one daughter named Khara and Shurpanakha.

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणस्तु रूपेण सर्वेभ्योऽभ्यधिकोऽभवत्। स बभूव महाभागो धर्मगोप्ता क्रियारतिः॥९॥
verses.english: In beauty Vibhishana surpassed them all; he grew very pious and used to perform rites.

verses.sanskrit: दशग्रीवस्तु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। महोत्साहो महावीर्यो महासत्त्वपराक्रमः॥१०॥
verses.english: That foremost of Rakshasas, the ten-headed (Ravana) became the greatest of them all; highly energetic, powerful and gifted with great strength and prowess.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णो बलेनासीत् सर्वेभ्योऽभ्यधिको युधि। मायावी रणशौण्डश्च रौद्रश्च रजनीचरः॥११॥
verses.english: The Rakshasa Kumbhakarna was the most powerful in battle; he was fierce, terrible and a perfect master of the arts of illustration.

verses.sanskrit: खरो धनुषि विक्रान्तो ब्रह्मद्विट् पिशिताशनः। सिद्धविघ्नकरी चापि रौद्री शूर्पणखा तदा॥१२॥
verses.english: Khara was proficient in archery, inimical towards Brahmanas and used to eat flesh; Shurpanakha used always to put impediments in the performance of ascetic observances.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वेदविदः शूराः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। ऊषुः पित्रा सह रता गन्धमादनपर्वते॥१३॥
verses.english: All those heroes, well-versed in the Vedas and intent on the performance of religious rites, lived with their father in the Gandhamadana mountain.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वैश्रवणं तत्र ददृशुर्नरवाहनम्। पित्रा सार्धं समासीनमृद्ध्या परमया युतम्॥१४॥
verses.english: There they saw Vaishravana seated with their father possessed of wealth and carried by men.

verses.sanskrit: जातामर्षास्ततस्ते तु तपसे धृतनिश्चयाः। ब्रह्माणं तोषयामासुर्घोरेण तपसा तदा॥१५॥
verses.english: Possessed by jealousy they made up their mind to perform devout penances; and they pleased Brahma with severest ascetic penances.

verses.sanskrit: अतिष्ठदेकपादेन सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्। वायुभक्षो दशग्रीवः पञ्चाग्निः सुसमाहितः॥१६॥
verses.english: Subsisting on air only surrounded by five sacred fires and engaged in meditation the tenheaded Ravana remained standing on one leg for a thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: अधःशायी कुम्भकर्णो यताहारो यतव्रतः। विभीषणः शीर्णपर्णमेकमभ्यवहारयन्॥१७॥
verses.english: Lying down on earth and with restricted diet Kumbhakarna was engaged in penances; the wise and noble Vibhishana, fasting and living on dry leaves, engaged in meditation and practised devout penances for as long a period.
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्चदिक्षु चत्वार एकः सूर्य इति पञ्चानामग्नीनां मध्यगः पञ्चाग्निः ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: उपवासरतिर्धीमान् सदा जप्यपरायणः। तमेव कालमातिष्ठत् तीव्रं तप उदारधीः॥१८॥
खरः शूर्पणखा चैव तेषां वै तप्यतां तपः। परिचर्यां च रक्षां च चक्रतुर्हृष्टमानसौ॥१९॥
verses.english: Khara and Shurpanakha with delighted hearts waited upon and protected them who were thus engaged in devout penances.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्त्रे तु शिरच्छित्वा दशाननः। जुहोत्यग्नौ दुराधर्षस्तेनातुष्यज्जगत्प्रभुः॥२०॥
verses.english: After the completion of a thousand years the invincible ten-headed, cutting off his ten heads, made them an offering to the sacred fire. The Lord of the universe was pleased with this act.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयं गत्वा तपसस्तान्न्यवारयत्। प्रलोभ्य वरदानेन सर्वानेव पृथक् पृथक्॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereupon Brahma, going there himself, made them desist from ascetic observances by promising to confer upon each one of them boons separately.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              प्रीतोऽस्मि वो निवर्तध्वं वरान् वृणुत पुत्रकाः। यद्यदिष्टमृते त्वेकममरत्वं तथाऽस्तु तत्॥२२॥
verses.english: Brahma said: I am pleased with you, desist, O sons and pray for boons; all your desires, with the exception of immortality only, will be fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदग्नौ हुतं सर्वं शिरस्ते महदीप्सया। तथैव तानि ते देहे भविष्यन्ति यथेप्सया॥२३॥
verses.english: As you have given your heads to fire from great ambition, they will again adorn your body as before, according to your desire.

verses.sanskrit: वैरूप्यं च न ते देहे कामरूपधरस्तथा। भविष्यसि रणेऽरीणां विजेता न च संशयः॥२४॥
verses.english: There will be no disfigurement in your person; you shall be able to assume any person according to your desire, you shall always vanquish your enemies in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
रावण उवाच।
              गन्धर्वदेवासुरतो यक्षराक्षसतस्तथा। सर्पकिन्नरभूतेभ्यो न मे भूयात् पराभवः॥२५॥
verses.english: Ravana said: May I never meet with defeat at the hands of Gandharvas, celestials, Kinnaras Asuras, Yakshas, Rakshasas, Nagas and all other creatures.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच। य एते कीर्तिताः सर्वे न तेभ्योऽस्ति भयं तव। ऋते मनुष्याद्भद्रं ते तथा तद्विहितं मया॥२६॥
verses.english: Brahma said: You shall have no fear from those of whom you have mentioned except from men; may good betide you, this has been ordained by me.

verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवस्तुष्टः समभवत् तदा। अवमेने हि दुर्बुद्धिर्मनुष्यान् पुरुषादकः॥२७॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : Thus accosted the ten headed Ravana was greatly delighted; on account of his perverted understanding, the man-eating (demon) disregarded human beings.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णमथोवाच तथैव प्रपितामहः। स वव्रे महतीं निद्रां तमसा ग्रस्तचेतनः॥२८॥
verses.english: In the same way the grandfather addressed Kumbhakarna also; his reason being clouded by darkness he prayed for long lasting sleep.

verses.sanskrit: तथा भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा विभीषणमुवाच ह। वरं वृणीष्व पुत्र त्वं प्रीतोऽस्मीति पुनः पुनः॥२९॥
verses.english: Saying "So it shall be" he said to Vibhishana, “pray for a boon, O my son, I have been repeatedly pleased with you."

verses.sanskrit:
विभीषण उवाच।
              परमापद्गतस्यापि नाधर्मे मे मतिर्भवेत्। अशिक्षितं च भगवन् ब्रह्मास्त्रं प्रतिभातु मे॥३०॥
verses.english: Vibhishana said: Even in great calamity may I have no inclination for impiety; ignorant, as I am, O lord, may the light of divine knowledge appear before me.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              यस्माद्राक्षसयोनौ ते जातस्यामित्रकर्शन। नाधर्मे धीयते बुद्धिरमरत्वं ददानि ते॥३१॥
verses.english: Brahma said : O repressor of your enemies, as your mind is not inclined to impiety, although you are born as a Rakshasas, I grant you immortality.

verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              राक्षसस्तु वरं लब्ध्वा दशग्रीवो विशाम्पते। लङ्कायाश्च्यावयामास युधि जित्वा धनेश्वरम्॥३२॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : Having obtained this boon, the ten-headed Ravana defeated Kubera in battle and wrested from him the sovereignty of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit: हित्वा स भगवाँल्लङ्कामाविशद्गन्धमादनम्। गन्धर्वयक्षानुगतो रक्षः किं पुरुषैः सह॥३३॥
verses.english: That Divine one leaving Lanka and followed by Gandharva, Yakshas, Rakshasas and Kinnaras went to live on the mor atain Gandhamadana.

verses.sanskrit: विमानं पुष्पकं तस्य जहाराक्रम्य रावणः। शशाप तं वैश्रवणो न त्वामेतद्वहिष्यति॥३४॥
verses.english: By force Ravana took from him the chariot Pushpaka. Vaishravana then cursed him, “This will not carry you;

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु त्वां समरे हन्ता तमेवैतद्वहिष्यति। अवमन्य गुरुं मां च क्षिप्रं त्वं न भविष्यसि॥३५॥
verses.english: It will carry him who will kill you in battle; as you have insulted me who am your adorable, you shall soon die.”

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा सतां मार्गमनुस्मरन्। अन्वगच्छन् महाराज श्रिया परमया युतः॥३६॥
verses.english: Always wending the way of the pious, those virtuous-souled Vibhishana, endued with great glory, followed him, O great king.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै स भगवांस्तुष्टो भ्राता भ्रात्रे धनेश्वरः। सैनापत्यं ददौ धीमान् यक्षराक्षससेनयोः॥३७॥
verses.english: Then pleased with his younger brother, the Divine king of wealth, conferred upon him the command of the Yaksha and Rakshasa hosts.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसाः पुरुषादाश्च पिशाचाश्च महाबालाः। सर्वे समेत्य राजानमभ्यषिञ्चन् दशाननम्॥३८॥
verses.english: The man-eating and highly powerful Rakshasas and Pishachas, having assembled together, installed the ten-headed Ravana as their king.

verses.sanskrit: दशग्रीवश्च दैत्यानां देवानां च बलोत्कटः। आक्रम्य रत्नान्यहरत् कामरूपी विहङ्गमः॥३९॥
verses.english: The terribly powerful, ten-headed (Ravana) assuming form at will and capable of going through the sky, attacked the gods and demons and took away by force from them their valuable property.

verses.sanskrit: रावयामास लोकान् यत् तस्माद्रावण उच्यते। दशग्रीवः कामबलो देवानां भयमादधत्॥४०॥
verses.english: Because he had terrified all creatures he was called Ravana. And the ten-headed demon, capable of having any might at will, struck terror even to the very gods.
verses.bhavadeepa: रत्नानि । ‘जातौ जातौ यदुत्कृष्टं तद्रत्नमभिधीयते’। विहङ्गमः खेचरः ॥३९॥
